description: Improve, redesign, polish or rebrand an existing presentation. Pass the text of every slide of the user's uploaded PowerPoint, Google Slides or Keynote deck (title and body, in order). PitchBoost keeps the content and figures, rebuilds every slide with professional layout in the user's brand, checks every number against the source, and returns a shareable link (the PowerPoint and PDF download from the web app). Generation runs in the background for 2 to 4 minutes: this call returns a deal_id at once; call get_rebuild_status with it to get the link when ready.

deal_name.description: Optional name for the deck in the user's dashboard. Defaults to the first slide title.

instructions.description: Optional guidance from the user, for example the audience, tone, or slides to emphasise. Up to 1000 characters.

mode.description: preserve (default) keeps one slide per source slide; condense compresses a long deck to about 10 to 15 slides.

slides.description: The source deck, one entry per slide in order. Extract these from the user's uploaded file: title is the slide heading if any, body is all other text on the slide.

body.description: All other text on the slide, including bullet points and chart labels.

name: rebuild_deck
title: Rebuild an existing deck
